label: Free (1996) / Free et al. (1998)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA, horizontal and vertical) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

site.anchor_note: C6_soil confirms rock as the reference class.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; no OpenQuake implementation and the thesis/paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

parameters.equation_shape: log y = linear + quadratic magnitude terms + geometric-spreading/log-distance term + linear distance attenuation + site flag + magnitude-dependent pseudo-depth term

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for both components. PGA coefficients C1-C6, h0 and sigma for horizontal and vertical are now available. The magnitude scale is still not stated.

implementation_notes: Keep horizontal and vertical sets separate; test both.
Warn for active-crustal or subduction use.
The magnitude range reaches down to ~1.5 - unusually low. Preserve it rather than clipping to a modern floor.
